scope: Two predetermined coherent native library profiles; isolated diagnostics only; no main or packaging changes.

profiles.name: aocl_default_scalar
profiles.license: AMD contributions BSD-3-Clause; retain LICENSE and third-party NOTICES. Selected scalar public amd_ API; source-defined runtime dispatch only.
profiles.rationale: Distinct optimized tanf pi/32 table reduction and rational/reconstruction algorithm; evaluate complete public scalar math profile, not CORE-MATH-only assumption.

profiles.name: openlibm_default_scalar
profiles.license: Library retains BSD/ISC/fdlibm and Julia MIT notices in LICENSE.md/source headers. LGPL test-double/test-float programs are not built or proposed for production.
profiles.rationale: Independent fdlibm-derived complete scalar profile. No assumption correct rounding implies original MKL parity.

build: bash build_linux.sh > build.log 2>&1 (packet directory cwd; CMake >=3.26 and GNU C/C++ compiler; single build job; no global install)
probe_template: python probe_profile.py --library ABSOLUTE_BUILT_SHARED_LIBRARY --prefix PREFIX --corpus CORPUS --asvf-oracle ASVF_ORACLE --sqrt-oracle SQRT_ORACLE --trace TRACE --output OUTPUT_DIR
execution_requirements: Cura owner executes in new ledger-owned directory; confirm idle before native build/probe; one process, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1.

Retain source tarballs/notices, compiler/CMake versions, CMakeCache/build logs, ldd output, library and probe hashes, report.json/results.npz. Discover built .so paths explicitly; never fall back to system libm. Probe checks each exported symbol origin.
No MKL/Torch dependency for candidate probe; retained upstream arrays are reference only. Original asvf diagnostic branch cannot constitute complete profile pass.
Run 189220 ASVF inputs then 774x153 actual scalar-call boundary oracle. Do not compare old vector classifier masks in torch_reference.npz.
If library build or Intel-host CPU dispatch fails, record failure; do not broaden to configuration sweep. Hash-verify local downloaded artifacts before removing owned remote scratch.

gates.advance: Complete profile sun=0 and shade=0 on actual boundary oracle; inspect all ASVF/primitive bit and nonfinite disagreements, no requirement to reject harmless bit differences automatically.
gates.next_if_pass: All frozen solar timesteps, block/layout/threads and M1 qualification; isolated genuine chronological dense1024+vegetation1024, all fields, 153 patches, 24h, unchanged frozen tolerances, 12GiB cap; installed wheel noTorch checks. Source-derived portability and licensing review before any production choice.
gates.stop_if_fail: Reject these profiles. Do not fit coefficients, switch algorithms by input, use lookup/surrogate/nextafter, relax masks/tolerances, or run full pipeline on a boundary-failing candidate.

finite_research_limit: Two new profiles only. Existing IGC MIT HA/FMA profile and SLEEF u10/u35 plus BSD SVML LA are already measured failures. No speculative compiler/FMA/config sweeps: FMA in source has defined semantics and removing it creates another algorithm, not an exactness repair. Failure does not prove mathematical impossibility; it establishes no demonstrated portable replacement from this finite source-licensed set. Original proprietary MKL compatibility remains unresolved and release numerical gates remain open.
verification: Python compile(), bash -n, C syntax check passed locally. Linux builds/runtime tests not yet executed.
